description: Guards credit-spending DataKart enrichment calls: spend may only start after the user has seen the preflight cost and explicitly approved it.

hooks.prompt: This DataKart tool call can spend enrichment credits. Approve it only if either (a) confirm_spend and start_immediately are absent/false (preflight-only), or (b) the conversation shows the user explicitly approved the spend after seeing the preflight cost estimate. If confirm_spend=true without visible explicit user approval, deny with the reason 'Show the preflight cost to the user and get explicit spend approval before setting confirm_spend=true.'
